San Francisco Giants offseason notes: The Giants agreed to terms on a 2027 contract with Camilo Doval (who will reportedly earn $6.3 million) and tendered contracts LHP Sam Hentges, RHP Randy Rodriguez and INF Casey Schmitt. RHP Rowan Wick and OF Victor Bericoto were non-tendered.

Boston Red Sox offseason notes: The Red Sox traded Johan Oviedo on Friday but tendered contracts to 14 players, including Triston Casas and Jarren Duran More on the moves: www.nytimes.com/athletic/779...
Braxton Roxby: The Nationals also traded RHP Braxton Roxby (who was DFA’d this week) to the Cubs for cash considerations.
Leo Balcazar: The #reds tendered contracts to all 11 of their arbitration eligible players. They did non tender SS Leo Balcazar.

Johan Oviedo: Red Sox officially announce they've traded Johan Oviedo to Arizona for minor league LHP Luke Dotson and a player to be named later. They've tendered contracts to all remaining players on the roster.

Washington Nationals offseason notes: The Nationals non-tendered LHP Jared Simpson as well as RHP Josiah Gray and LHP Carson Palmquist (who were both DFA'd earlier this week). All other unsigned players were tendered a 2027 contract, including the 3 arbitration-eligible guys: CJ Abrams, Jake Irvin and Jake Bird.

Detroit Tigers offseason notes: Arbitration-eligible Tigers who got tenders: RHP Beau Brieske OF Kerry Carpenter OF Riley Greene LHP Tyler Holton OF Parker Meadows IF/OF Zach McKinstry RHP Reese Olson OF Wenceel Pérez 1B Spencer Torkelson RHP Will Vest
Davis Schneider: Story on the #BlueJays' decision to non-tender Davis Schneider, a fan favorite in Toronto who struggled to find a permament role with the club in 2026: www.mlb.com/bluejays/new...
Matt Vierling: Tigers tendered contracts to all 10 arb-eligible players on their 40-man roster. No non-tenders beyond Matt Vierling, who was designated for assignment on Tuesday.
Mark Vientos: Mark Vientos was tendered a contract by the Mets Cionel Perez deal with Mets is for $1.9M
Christian Koss: The Giants traded INF Christian Koss to the Rays in exchange for RHP Cole Stokes, a 2026 12-round Draft pick out of Florida State.
Bobby Miller: Bobby Miller for Royce Lewis is just a fascinating trade for so many reasons and is probably going to be about 3% as meaningful on the field as the name value would imply
Gus Varland: Mets announce they've claimed Gus Varland (who was DFA'd earlier this week) off waivers from the Nationals.

Taylor Trammell: Taylor Trammell started more games than any Astro in left field last season. Non-tendering him on Friday accentuates just how much Houston must reimagine its entire outfield - www.nytimes.com/athletic/779...
Royce Lewis: Source confirms to @feinsand.bsky.social that Royce Lewis is being traded to the Dodgers. No additional details yet. We're just about to talk to Shelton so... we'll see!
Nolan Gorman: Cardinals say they’ve non-tendered Nolan Gorman and Max Rajcic, officially. 40-player goes to 39.

Cleveland Guardians offseason notes: The Guardians have non-tendered David Fry. They reached one-year deals with Matt Festa, Colin Holderman and Blake Perkins to avoid arbitration. Tendered contract to remaining arb eligible and pre-arb players on 40-man roster (now at 39 players).

Troy Melton: Troy Melton was not yet arb eligible, having just over a year of service time. His 6-year, $46.5m extension pending physical is the longest contract for a Tigers pitcher since Verlander's 7-year extension in 2013. It would cover Melton's arb years plus a year of free agency, 2 with a club option.

Houston Astros offseason notes: The Astros officially non-tendered Taylor Trammell. Their six other arb-eligible players were tendered: Jeremy Peña, Hunter Brown, Yainer Diaz, Peter Lambert and Hayden Wesneski. Bennett Sousa and Nick Allen also agreed to terms, avoiding arbitration.
Chase Lee: The #BlueJays have traded reliever Chase Lee, recently DFA'd, to the Rockies for cash.
Gavin Sheets: Gavin Sheets and Padres have a deal: $11M, 3 years

Labor and the CBA: MLB spokesman Glen Caplin says MLB dropped its proposal to eliminate draft eligibility for high school players as part of bargaining today. Reiterates MLB’s continued preference for an international draft. (Ctrl+c, ctrl+V) MLB did not drop its proposal for a salary cap.
Trevor Larnach: 1 year ago: Man, I cannot believe the Twins tendered Trevor Larnach today: huh, kind of surprising a little the Twins non-tendered Trevor Larnach
Bailey Ober: Confirmed that Twins will non-tender Bailey Ober. Unfortunate but not a big surprise. I would assume they tried to trade him and just couldn’t find a taker.
Milwaukee Brewers staff and front office: If Matt Arnold called in sick and you were Brewers GM for the day, would any of these non-tender candidates intrigue you? www.mlb.com/news/non-ten...

Cincinnati Reds offseason notes: The deadline to tender contracts to arbitration-eligible players is today at 5 p.m. ET. (aka the non-tender deadline)... The arb-eligible #reds are: Abbott, Antone, Ashcraft, Bleday, De La Cruz, Lodolo, McLain, Myers, Santillan, Steer and Williamson.
New York Mets offseason notes: The eight-step plan to get the Mets back in contention. Free to read:

Darwinzon Hernández: Can now confirm Mets and Darwinzon Hernandez are in agreement on a 3yr deal worth $12M, according to a person familiar with the deal. Great numbers, won title, averaged more than a K/inning while seemingly getting his walks down in NBP. Need new arms to cover a lot of innings. Should help.
Christian Cairo: The #BlueJays have claimed INF Christian Cairo off waivers from the Los Angeles Dodgers. Reliever Chase Lee DFA’d to make room on the 40-man.
Carter Baumler: Orioles receive reliever Carter Baumler back from Rangers, claim right-hander Braden Nett from Athletics #Orioles

Houston Astros staff and front office: The Astros are hiring Bobby Wilson as bench coach on Brad Ausmus' staff, sources tell @ken-rosenthal.bsky.social and me. Wilson, who caught for parts of 10 seasons in the big leagues, spent last season as Nationals catching coach and run game coordinator - www.nytimes.com/athletic/779...

Sonny Gray: Sonny Gray was open to returning to the Red Sox, having put the rancor after Game 2 behind him. But their focus has been on the lineup. He certainly took advantage of the market for starters.
Tarik Skubal: Tarik Skubal comes first, but Freddy Peralta is the #BlueJays' type on the second tier of the pitching market. A look at the potential fit: www.mlb.com/bluejays/new...
Free agency: Sifting through possible free-agent starters for Orioles #Orioles
Nick Fortes: The Red Sox release on trading for Nick Fortes and DFA'ing Connor Wong mentions this about Wong ... ... "he was acquired by Boston in a five-player trade on February 10, 2020."

Vladimir Guerrero: Vladimir Guerrero Jr. told media in the Dominican Republic that, when he was traded (in LIDOM) to Tigres del Licey yesterday, his daughter cried because she thought that it was from the #BlueJays He says he wants to play for Dominican fans who can’t see him play in-person in MLB

Around the market: New: Vladimir Guerrero Jr. wants to play winter ball with Tigres del Licey “Today, one of my dreams is coming true.” Now, he’s working on getting approval from the #BlueJays. Full story with comments from Guerrero today: www.mlb.com/bluejays/new...
Baltimore Orioles staff and front office: nypost.com/2026/11/18/s... Former Orioles manager Brandon Hyde has emerged as a candidate to be the Yankees bench coach.

Dominic Fletcher: According to a source, the #reds signed OF Dominic Fletcher to a Minor League contract with an invite to big league Spring Training. Fletcher, formerly of the White Sox and Diamondbacks, finished 2026 with Triple-A Louisville when he signed in September after being released by the Pirates org.

Omar Cruz: Nats have signed LHP Omar Cruz and INF Carlos Mendoza to minor-league contracts with spring training invites. Cruz pitched in Padres system last 3 years, had 14.1K/9 IP this season at AA/AAA. Mendoza is left-handed utilityman who had .727 OPS with Blue Jays' AAA team this year.

Connor Wong: The Red Sox announced that they designated Connor Wong for assignment. That clears a 40-man roster spot for Nick Fortes, the new backup catcher, whose trade from the Rays also is now official.
Jace Jung: The Tigers have traded INF Jace Jung to the Los Angeles Angels for a cash consideration.
Josiah Gray: The Nationals’ decision to DFA Josiah Gray was a tough pill to swallow, but it was a reminder this front office isn’t beholden to players it inherited. natsjournal.com/p/despite-in...

The trade market: Of the four prospects added, three were players acquired in trades: - Zazueta from NYY in the Caleb Ferguson deal - Ferris from CHC in the Michael Busch deal - Serwinowski from CIN in a three-teamer The fourth, Luke Fox, was taken in the 17th round of the draft.

Jake Bauers: While it seemed like an odd fit initially, Craig Breslow said the Red Sox had targeted Jake Bauers as early as June as a player who’d fit their roster. He called Bauers’ agent as soon as free agency opened and officially had Bauers signed 15 days later www.nytimes.com/athletic/779...

Los Angeles Dodgers offseason notes: The Dodgers added Christian Zazueta, Jackson Ferris, Adam Serwinowski and Luke Fox to their 40-man roster to protect them from the Rule 5 Draft (if there is one). To clear spots, they DFA'd Jake Cousins and Christian Cairo.
